rate_limits: No request limit. The provider may reject requests it considers abusive or inappropriate. Services regularly generating more than 10,000 requests per day should notify the provider.
description: Simple free public HTTP API from goQR.me that turns submitted text or URLs into QR code images. The create-qr-code endpoint supports PNG, GIF, JPEG/JPG, SVG, and EPS output without signup, making it useful for embeds, email signatures, and print assets.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: Verifiers are correct.
